user.title: Connect to QWeather
user.description: Enter the API Host from your QWeather console, without a scheme or path. Location is longitude,latitude. Interval is in seconds; all products use up to six requests per refresh.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure QWeather
reconfigure.description: Leave API Key blank to keep the existing key. The weather entity ID is preserved after a location change.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to fetch weather. Check API Host, key, permissions, quota and connectivity.
error.invalid_settings: Check your coordinates and numeric ranges.

init.title: QWeather options
init.description: Interval is in seconds (minimum 300). The 24-hour precipitation total requires at least 24 forecast hours. Disabling a supplemental product makes its screen data unavailable.
